items.title: Aussie fintech Safewill raises A$15m
items.why: Institutional partnership push by a planning fintech is a template for embedded benefit deals, though the fit with premium cards is loose.
items.summary_ai: Australian end-of-life planning fintech Safewill raised a A$15m Series C to expand bank, super fund and insurer partnerships.
items.take: Institutional partnership push by a planning fintech is a template for embedded benefit deals, though the fit with premium cards is loose.
